$cs='Server=YASIN-YASIN\SQLEXPRESS;Database=LUMAR_ERP_TEST;Integrated Security=True;TrustServerCertificate=True'
$cn=New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection $cs
$cn.Open()

  $cmd=$cn.CreateCommand()
  $cmd.CommandText=@'
WITH blocked AS (
 SELECT EmployeeID,EmployeeCode,EmployeeName,IsActive,SalaryType,BasicSalary,PieceWageRate,HireDate
 FROM dbo.Employees
 WHERE SalaryType IS NULL OR SalaryType NOT IN(N'BasicSalary',N'PieceWage')
    OR (SalaryType=N'BasicSalary' AND BasicSalary<=0)
    OR (SalaryType=N'PieceWage' AND BasicSalary<>0)
)
SELECT b.EmployeeID,b.EmployeeCode,b.EmployeeName,b.IsActive,b.SalaryType,b.BasicSalary,b.PieceWageRate,b.HireDate,
 COUNT(DISTINCT pr.PayrollRecordId) AS PayrollRecords,
 COUNT(DISTINCT pi.PayrollItemId) AS PayrollItems,
 COUNT(DISTINCT pw.PieceWageRecordID) AS PieceWageRecords,
 COUNT(DISTINCT ea.EmployeeAttendanceId) AS AttendanceRecords,
 MIN(pr.PayrollRecordId) AS FirstPayrollRecord,MAX(pr.PayrollRecordId) AS LastPayrollRecord,
 MIN(pw.PieceWageRecordID) AS FirstPieceWageRecord,MAX(pw.PieceWageRecordID) AS LastPieceWageRecord,
 SUM(CASE WHEN pr.BasicSalaryAmount>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BasicPayrollCount,
 SUM(CASE WHEN pr.PieceWageAmount>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PiecePayrollCount,
 SUM(CASE WHEN pi.ItemType LIKE N'%Piece%' OR pi.ItemName LIKE N'%قطعة%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PiecePayrollItemCount,
 SUM(CASE WHEN pi.ItemType LIKE N'%Salary%' OR pi.ItemName LIKE N'%راتب%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SalaryPayrollItemCount
FROM blocked b
LEFT JOIN dbo.PayrollRecords pr ON pr.EmployeeId=b.EmployeeID
LEFT JOIN dbo.PayrollItems pi ON pi.PayrollRecordId=pr.PayrollRecordId
LEFT JOIN dbo.PieceWageRecords pw ON pw.EmployeeId=b.EmployeeID
LEFT JOIN dbo.EmployeeAttendances ea ON ea.EmployeeId=b.EmployeeID
GROUP BY b.EmployeeID,b.EmployeeCode,b.EmployeeName,b.IsActive,b.SalaryType,b.BasicSalary,b.PieceWageRate,b.HireDate
ORDER BY b.EmployeeID;
'@
  $r=$cmd.ExecuteReader()
  while($r.Read()){ $v=for($i=0;$i -lt $r.FieldCount;$i++){if($r.IsDBNull($i)){''}else{$r.GetValue($i)}}; Write-Output ($v -join '|') }

} finally { $cn.Close() }
